# circuits_gpio v2.2.0 - Table of Contents

> Use GPIOs in Elixir

## Pages

- [Circuits - GPIO](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Porting](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/porting.md)
- [Changelog](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Circuits.GPIO](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/Circuits.GPIO.md): Control GPIOs from Elixir
- [Circuits.GPIO.Backend](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/Circuits.GPIO.Backend.md): Backends provide the connection to the real or virtual GPIO controllers

- [Circuits.GPIO.CDev](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/Circuits.GPIO.CDev.md): Circuits.GPIO backend that uses the Linux CDev for controlling GPIOs
- [Circuits.GPIO.Diagnostics](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/Circuits.GPIO.Diagnostics.md): Runtime diagnostics
- [Circuits.GPIO.Handle](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/Circuits.GPIO.Handle.md): Handle for referring to GPIOs
- [Circuits.GPIO.NilBackend](https://circuits-gpio.hexdocs.pm/Circuits.GPIO.NilBackend.md): Circuits.GPIO backend when nothing else is available
